answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25667 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is tarabi namaz compulsory? Do everyone have to perform tarabi namaz? Question: Is tarabi namaz compulsory? Do everyone have to perform tarabi namaz Answer ID: 25667 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1456/1456/M=1431) Yes, tarawih salah is sunnat-e-muakkada. Everyone should offer tarawih salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
